official_sources.source_identity: GravityView changelog; 3.5.0 latest entry and intervening 3.3.5/3.4.0 entries

capability_observations.summary: The intervening 3.4.0 release explicitly changes timezone behavior for {now}, {yesterday}, and {tomorrow} merge tags. This is nearby date/time contract evidence but does not establish any change to PersianGravity's field-specific raw UTC Entry-property presentation seam.

The intervening 3.3.5 release documents fixes for Gravity Forms 3.1.1+ and 3.5.0 adds new View output/query surfaces. PersianGravity's current GravityView adapter remains exact-package qualified at 3.3.4, so an Owner-supplied 3.5.0 package requires source/runtime qualification before admission.
